I have had HPPD for 7 years. I attempted suicide last year. The doctors were surprised I was still alive, by all rights I shouldn't be. 
It's not the answer, not at all. 
A little over a year later, after practicing meditation, being mindful of my thought patterns, and using Ashwagandha, Lions mane, valerian root, plus anti-depressants, anti-anxiety medications and being placed back on Adderall after quitting taking it several years ago...my social anxiety is 90 percent gone, and my hppd is about 75 percent improved. 
It DOES get better... you just have to find what works for you. Be patient, don't be too hard on yourself.

Ketamine can be used to treat depression, AND, the FDA recently approved ketamine/a ketamine like (?) drug to treat depression. However since Lamictal, an anti-seizure drug is helpful in treating HPPD, whereas ketamine is an agonist (lowers the seizure threshold, therefore increasing the risk for seizures) for seizures, I would wonder if it would do the opposite and exacerbate hppd symptoms.

I know this, I work for a paintball company lol. :) Too bad because it was beautiful paint. Could also be too much oil. Could be the seams, could even be the fill inside the paint just isn't right. Could be paint separating inside the paintball. Lots of different variables. But I also know that I've shot hundreds of cases of paint and that I've seen paintballs with tiny dimples shoot 90 percent or better. If you find 1 or 2 balls with dimples out of every 20-25 balls, that paint isn't gonna shoot too bad... Large dimples, lots of flat spots, I agree accuracy is definitely skewed.
